purpose: Determine whether the retained static cup-floor particle cluster is controlled by obstacle level-set surface distance or by resolution-dependent voxel classification before changing CFL or reconstructing a surface.

authority.scope: Three fresh local-only seven-frame Data bakes at Preview/Review resolution; zero Mesh bake, save, render, network or engine remote write; ordinary research commit and non-force push are allowed.

priorParticleFinding.finding: Nine ALIVE particles appeared on frames 4-7 at nine stable coordinates, reported zero RNA speed and lay 13.96487-20.23688 mm inside the modeled solid floor while remaining above the outer bottom.

sourceCodeBindings.observedRule: Liquid particle advancement and resampling use the obstacle phiObs field to push particles out and exclude obstacle cells.
Obstacle meshes are sampled into a signed-distance field and effector surface_distance expands that field in domain-grid units.
The RNA particle array is rebuilt from Mantaflow positions and velocities, excludes DELETE particles and marks the remaining display particles ALIVE; RNA indices are not cross-frame identities.

measurement.particleCoordinateConvention: Blender Particle.location world-space converted by cup.matrix_world.inverted
measurement.acceptedContainmentMargin: one current cell at the measured resolution
measurement.identityRule: Compare rounded coordinates, speed and physical region; never treat RNA display index as a stable particle identity.
measurement.cacheContract: Exactly one config and one Data VDB for each frame 1-7 in each fresh cell; no Mesh files.

interpretationTable.condition: preview baseline has outliers and preview +1-cell effector has zero
preview baseline and review baseline outlier counts differ without the surface-distance condition above
interpretationTable.nextCell: review-effector-plus1 when Review has outliers; otherwise final-resolution-baseline-reproduction

interpretationTable.condition: all three cells have zero one-cell-envelope outliers

interpretationTable.nextCell: cup topology, normals, Is Planar and applied-transform audit

stopRule: Stop on non-fresh roots, dirty research worktree, input/source-code drift, source geometry or placement drift, cell/configuration mismatch, missing evaluated particles, aggregate/detail mismatch, cache roster other than exact 14 config/Data files per cell, process/log/result failure, any Mesh bake/save/render/network/remote-write count, symlink, banned media or resource failure. Do not enable Delete in Obstacle, do not vary CFL/timesteps and do not proceed to slow tip in this attempt.
claimCeiling: One three-cell Data-only Preview/Review screen for obstacle-level-set and resolution signals in the static cup. It can select the next diagnostic cell only; it does not prove a Final-resolution correction, reconstructed-surface quality, slow tip, impact, render or finished-film quality.
